answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The effect is that voting power tracks real contribution, so a flood of accounts cannot outvote a smaller set of genuinely established participants.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a quartz as the anchor of the cost.
